description: Move archived notifications back to your list, for this reader only: pass ids (at most 100), as list_notifications with view archived returns them. Works for an item that archive all covered too; the rest stays archived. Answers 404 (not released) until notification archive is switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with notifications write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

ids.description: Notification ids, as list_notifications returns them (such as approval:<uuid>).

name: unarchive_notifications
